newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable in quiet trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Tuesday, with healthy gains in Malaysia failing to lift local values, traders said.

They said olein was quoted at 1,430-35 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but offers were also heard at five rupiah above and below the range. They said crude palm oil was on offer at 1,250-55 rupiah/kg in Medan.
"The market did not follow the increases in Malaysia," one trader said. "Local prices are still under pressure due in part to market operations by (state logistics agency) BULOG."
BULOG has been carrying out intervention selling in a bid to put a lid on cooking oil prices ahead of Eid al-Fitr early next month, selling olein at 1,435 rupiah.
Traders said an anticipated increase in consumer demand ahead of the Moslem festival had yet to materialise, and were hoping demand would improve by next week.

Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Wawasan Murni will leave for Port Klang, Malaysia with 11,750 tonnes of crude palm oil on Thursday. The KM Permaisuri will leave on Wednesday for Tanjung Priok in Jakarta with 2,200 tonnes of olein.
